review:
Zeus Ze Zecond is a sequel that blends the Ze Zeus character with the Le Zeus reveal mechanic. Wonder symbols drop vertically on reels 2 to 5 and reveal high-paying symbols, wilds or full Wonder Reels. Any win made with revealed symbols triggers sticky respins that continue until nothing new connects or a Wonder Reel appears.

Wonder Reels hold coins, diamonds, clovers and Pots of Olympus, which gather everything into one total. In the Godly Ascension bonus, a Wonder Meter fills toward reward spins on a full grid of Wonder symbols, with the minimum coin tier rising on each one. That's where the 20,000x maximum comes into play.
